strengths: The main review pack Markdown is short and covers artifact inventory, paper audits, accounting, dashboard state, operator inbox, warnings, safety flags, and next safe manual actions.
Safety boundaries are explicit: local-only, no recommendations, no decisions, no network/API, no wallet, no trading, no autonomous paper orders, and no scoring/probability/EV/edge.
Paper audit status is easy to find and currently clean: reconciliation_passed and batch_audit_passed with 0 audit warnings and 0 audit mismatches.
Operator inbox review clearly separates accepted, rejected, and needs-human-review records without execution authority.
weaknesses: There was no dedicated operator quickstart before this task.
The generated review pack does not clearly say what to open first.
QUALITY-001 warning volume is high and the Markdown does not group warnings by severity or type before the full list.
Accounting PnL values can be misread as profitability unless the accounting-only boundary is repeated next to the values.
Bridge examples are safe but command-shaped, which can confuse operators without a static-mapping-only reminder.
The tracked review pack reports optional INFRA-009 artifacts as missing even though those files are present in this workspace, so regenerated artifacts can churn.
There is no single local command to regenerate the complete workbench package.
recommended_improvements: Add an operator entrypoint and reading order directly to the generated review pack.
Add quality warning severity and category summaries before full warning detail.
Repeat the accounting-only PnL boundary beside every PnL value.
Add plain-language dashboard status beside machine-readable status.
Create one local deterministic command to regenerate the operator workbench package from existing local artifacts.

warning_classification_summary.blocking_guidance: Block if required artifacts are missing, required JSON cannot parse, quality blockers are non-empty, report status becomes failed/blocked, unsafe safety values appear, runtime/network/trading/scoring behavior appears, command execution authority appears, orders are created, or tests fail for new or unknown reasons.
warning_classification_summary.non_blocking_guidance: Current warnings are inventory, staleness, metadata, embedded pointer, optional missing artifact, known intentional malformed fixture, and fixture alignment hygiene warnings only.
